item.title: Nationalism Can Curb Doctor Brain Drain, Says KPPA
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Public Service DG Wan Ahmad Dahlan says doctor brain drain can be curbed if doctors have a "sense of nationalism to help the country", amid very low housemen intake. MMA says doctors leave because "the system and policy don't reciprocate their love." The post Nationalism Can Curb Doctor Brain Drain, Says KPPA appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Beyond Chemo, New Blood Cancer Treatments Bring Hope In Malaysia
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
A haematologist at Sunway Medical Centre, Sunway City, says stem cell transplant can be curative in many instances, while CAR-T cell therapy is lifesaving in Refractory B cell lymphoma, B cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia and multiple myeloma. The post Beyond Chemo, New Blood Cancer Treatments Bring Hope In Malaysia appeared first on CodeBlue .
